checks: 19 exact native tests twice debug/release; repeated syntax; three compiled source mutants
cost: sample O(R log G); precision O(S*O + S*V*Gverbs), recall O(Gentries*S*V); rows/strings allocated. shift addition must fit usize. No frozen assessment run.
description: Own-rule selection and synthetic gold precision/recall accounting.
forward: sample selects matching owner jurisdiction and sentence membership. judge_rule matches force and any act/condition verb, authority ASCII-insensitive. precision maps sentence through supplied order+shift, omits unavailable gold, excludes '?' authority denominator; recall counts each expected entry once if any sample matches.
inverse: Excluded outputs include judging a sample absent from order, counting inherited rules as own when r.jur!=j.id, and unknown '?' authority increasing authority denominator. Metric correctness does not establish real legal precision.

Formatted precision recovers compatible integer counts up to rounding and supplied sample size, not unique rules/gold. Recall hits ignore duplicate extracted matches; many corpora share the same formatted percentage.
judged counts only available ordered gold; fa uses judged, authority uses known gold among judged, both treats unknown authority as unconstrained. No single shared denominator is valid.
For matching order position k, compare gold[order[(k+shift)%len]]; absence of position returns None before modulo, so empty order is safe. Duplicate order names use first occurrence.

For each expected(force,verbs), hit iff some same-sentence extracted rule has force and intersects verbs across acts+conditions. One extracted rule can satisfy multiple expected rows; no bijective matching.

read_gold overwrites duplicate sentence keys, ignores notes, missing second column means no rules, malformed force/verb errors. gold_order retains repeated sentence order independently; these representations can disagree.
limitations: Partial source-derived models and finite correspondence only
No live parser/corpus/frozen gold or protocol filesystem effects; no percentage surrogate
state: Finite synthetic rule/case states; valid indices, bounded paths, successful allocations. No legal authority claim.
